title: Dynamic Screening of Buyers With Heterogeneous Purchase Frequency
title_zh: 异质性购买频率下买家的动态筛选
authors: Johannes Hörner, Anna Sanktjohanser
abstract: We consider a dynamic buyer–seller interaction. Instead of the buyer's valuation, it is the frequency with which he needs to trade that is the buyer's private information. The difference matters. With commitment, full surplus extraction is possible, for instance via limited‐time offers. Without commitment, ratcheting is mitigated, as not buying is not necessarily a sign of strength. Because time is informative, the seller learns and may adjust her behavior over time. When finding a suitable alternative seller is easy, she starts with a pooling offer before permanently switching to a screening offer. When finding a suitable alternative seller takes time, she starts with a pooling offer before occasionally experimenting with separating offers.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一种动态的买卖双方互动关系。与买方估值不同，买方需要交易的频率才是其私人信息。这一差异至关重要。在有承诺的情况下，完全剩余提取是可能的，例如通过限时报价。在没有承诺的情况下，棘轮效应得到缓解，因为不购买并不一定意味着买方处于强势地位。由于时间具有信息价值，卖方会随着时间推移学习并可能调整其行为。当寻找合适的替代卖方较为容易时，她会先提出混合报价，然后永久转向筛选报价。当寻找合适的替代卖方需要时间时，她会先提出混合报价，然后偶尔尝试分离报价。

title: The Segregative Effects of Charter Schools
title_zh: 特许学校的隔离效应
authors: Angela Crema
abstract: I study the effects of charters on student racial segregation, identifying a novel mechanism: the assignment of White and non-White students to regular classrooms within their school-grade. Exploiting almost 100 entries of elementary charters in North Carolina from 1997 to 2015, I show that the announcement of an opening significantly increases classroom segregation within public schools nearby, relative to schools farther away, especially within non-majority-White schools and for charter openings that enroll a relatively large share of White students. Accounting for classrooms is unlikely to reverse the literature’s conclusion that the charter effects on student segregation are modest in magnitude. (JEL H75, I21, I24, I28, J15)
abstract_zh: 本文研究了特许学校对学生种族隔离的影响，并识别出一种新机制：白人和非白人学生在其所在年级的常规班级中的分配。利用1997年至2015年间北卡罗来纳州近100所小学特许学校的设立数据，我表明，与距离较远的学校相比，特许学校开学的公告显著增加了附近公立学校内部的班级隔离，尤其是在非白人占多数的学校以及招收白人学生比例相对较高的特许学校中。考虑班级层面的因素不太可能推翻文献中关于特许学校对学生隔离影响程度较小的结论。（JEL H75, I21, I24, I28, J15）

title: A Laboratory Test of Flow Trading
title_zh: 流动交易的一项实验室检验
authors: Friedman, Daniel, Li, Yilin, López Vargas, Kristian
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Perceived shortcomings in the dominant asset market format, CDA, have provoked reform proposals including Flow, which features gradual trading. We report a laboratory experiment comparing formats in a simple single-asset private values environment. We find that Flow reduces price volatility, enhances liquidity, and encourages traders to send fewer and larger orders, indicating more effective shredding. In our simple environment, both formats deliver comparable trading volume, allocative efficiency and price efficiency.
abstract_zh: 对主流资产市场形式CDA的感知缺陷引发了包括Flow在内的改革提案，其特点是渐进式交易。我们报告了一项实验室实验，在简单的单一资产私人价值环境中比较了不同市场形式。研究发现，Flow降低了价格波动性，增强了流动性，并促使交易者发送更少但更大的订单，表明更有效的订单拆分。在我们的简单环境中，两种形式在交易量、配置效率和价格效率方面表现相当。

title: Resetting the Innovation Clock: Endogenous Growth through Technological Turnover
title_zh: 重置创新时钟：技术更替驱动的内生增长
authors: Aghion, Philippe, Bergeaud, Antonin, Boppart, Timo, Brouillette, Jean-Félix
official: 来源期次 American Economic Review: Insights · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: We propose a model of endogenous economic growth with “weak” scale effects and diminishing returns to innovation at the micro level. In our model, entrants introduce new technologies through research and incumbents incrementally improve them through development. Over time, further improvement becomes harder such that firms ultimately run out of ideas and exit, paving the way for entrants that discover new technologies with further room for improvement. This turnover gives rise to a continuous stream of (temporary) opportunities for technological improvements that sustain economic growth. In a stationary equilibrium, the longrun growth rate is constant and endogenous to market incentives.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个具有“弱”规模效应和微观层面创新收益递减特征的内生经济增长模型。在该模型中，市场进入者通过研发引入新技术，而在位企业则通过开发活动对技术进行渐进式改进。随着时间推移，技术改进难度逐渐增大，企业最终因创新空间枯竭而退出市场，这为能够发现具有更大改进空间新技术的进入者创造了条件。这种企业更替机制产生了持续不断的（暂时性）技术改进机会，从而支撑经济长期增长。在稳态均衡中，长期增长率保持恒定，且内生于市场激励。

title: Risk Sharing Tests and Covariate Shocks: Drought, Floods, and Pests in Uganda
title_zh: 风险分担检验与协变量冲击：乌干达的干旱、洪涝与虫害
authors: Ligon, Ethan
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Efficient risk-sharing implies a simple factor structure for marginal utilities of expenditure (MUEs): Pareto weights divided by a common price. The standard approach infers MUEs from total expenditures, implicitly assuming homothetic preferences, unitary income elasticities, and identical price elasticities. Risk-sharing tests using total expenditures work for idiosyncratic shocks (budgets change, but not prices), but not “covariate” shocks (prices change). We describe all preferences which permit one to infer MUEs from expenditures, and estimate nonhomothetic MUEs to test whether covariate shocks are shared efficiently in Uganda. This delivers sensible results; the standard approach suggests that droughts, floods, and pests are beneficial.
abstract_zh: 有效风险分担意味着支出边际效用（MUEs）存在一个简单的因子结构：帕累托权重除以共同价格。标准方法通过总支出推断MUEs，隐含假设了同质性偏好、单位收入弹性以及相同的价格弹性。基于总支出的风险分担检验适用于异质性冲击（预算变化，但价格不变），但不适用于“协变量”冲击（价格变化）。我们描述了所有允许从支出推断MUEs的偏好类型，并估计了非同质性MUEs，以检验乌干达的协变量冲击是否得到有效分担。这一方法得出了合理的结果；而标准方法则暗示干旱、洪水和虫害是有益的。

title: Shifting Work Patterns with Generative AI
title_zh: 生成式AI带来的工作模式转变
authors: Dillon, Eleanor W., Jaffe, Sonia, Immorlica, Nicole, Stanton, Christopher T.
official: 来源期次 American Economic Review: Insights · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: We present evidence from a field experiment across 66 firms and 7,137 knowledge workers. Workers were randomly selected to access a generative AI tool integrated into applications they already used at work for email, meetings, and writing. In the second half of the 6-month experiment, the 80% of treated workers who used the tool spent two fewer hours on email each week and reduced their time working outside of regular hours. Apart from these individual time savings, we do not detect shifts in the quantity or composition of workers’ tasks resulting from individual-level AI provision.
abstract_zh: 我们通过一项涵盖66家企业和7,137名知识工作者的实地实验提供了证据。部分工作者被随机选中，获得一项生成式人工智能工具的访问权限，该工具已集成到他们工作中已使用的电子邮件、会议和写作应用程序中。在为期6个月的实验后半段，使用该工具的80%受试工作者每周在电子邮件上花费的时间减少了两个小时，并且减少了在常规工作时间之外的工作时长。除了这些个人时间节省外，我们未发现因个体层面提供人工智能而导致工作者任务数量或构成发生变化。

title: Unconditional Convergence in Manufacturing: A Reassessment
title_zh: 制造业的无条件收敛：一个再评估
authors: Herrendorf, Berthold, Rogerson, Richard, Valentinyi, Ákos
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: The movement of labor out of the agricultural sector is a central feature of the development process. A long-held belief is that successful development requires that much of the labor released from agriculture be allocated to manufacturing rather than services. Rodrik’s (2013) finding of unconditional convergence for manufacturing productivity using data from UNIDO provided empirical support for this view. We argue that the UNIDO data are ill–suited to study cross-country productivity dynamics. We use recently released data from the GGDC that was developed especially to study cross-country sectoral productivity dynamics to revisit this issue. We find no evidence of unconditional convergence in manufacturing productivity over the period 1990–2018.
abstract_zh: 劳动力从农业部门转移是发展进程的核心特征。长期以来，人们普遍认为成功的发展需要将农业释放的大部分劳动力配置到制造业而非服务业。Rodrik（2013）基于联合国工业发展组织（UNIDO）数据发现的制造业生产率无条件趋同现象，为这一观点提供了实证支持。我们认为UNIDO数据并不适用于研究跨国生产率动态。本文采用GGDC最新发布的、专为研究跨国部门生产率动态而开发的数据集重新审视该问题。研究发现，1990-2018年期间不存在制造业生产率无条件趋同的证据。

title: Binary choice under asymmetric loss in a data‐rich environment: Theory and an application to algorithmic fairness
title_zh: 数据丰富环境下非对称损失下的二元选择：理论与算法公平性应用
authors: Andrii Babii, Xi Chen, Eric Ghysels, Rohit Kumar
abstract: We study the binary choice problem in a data‐rich environment with asymmetric loss functions. The econometrics literature covers nonparametric binary choice problems but does not offer computationally attractive solutions in data‐rich environments. The machine learning literature has many algorithms but is focused mostly on loss functions that are independent of covariates. We show that theoretically valid decisions on binary outcomes with general loss functions can be achieved via a very simple loss‐based reweighting of logistic regression or state‐of‐the‐art machine learning techniques. We apply our analysis to algorithmic fairness in pretrial detentions.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了数据丰富环境下具有非对称损失函数的二元选择问题。计量经济学文献涵盖了非参数二元选择问题，但未提供在数据丰富环境中具有计算吸引力的解决方案。机器学习文献虽包含众多算法，但主要关注与协变量无关的损失函数。我们证明，通过基于损失函数对逻辑回归或前沿机器学习技术进行极其简单的重新加权，即可在一般损失函数下实现理论上有效的二元结果决策。我们将分析应用于审前羁押中的算法公平性问题。

title: Dynamic Individuals, Static Neighborhoods: Migration and Earnings Changes in Poor Neighborhoods
title_zh: 动态个体，静态社区：贫困社区的迁移与收入变化
authors: Andrew Garin, Ethan Jenkins, Evan E. Mast, Bryan A. Stuart
official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper studies migration and earnings dynamics in poor neighborhoods using new administrative data linking residential location and earnings. Out-migration rates are higher in poor neighborhoods than elsewhere, and the majority of people who leave a poor neighborhood move to a richer one. Residents of poor neighborhoods also see significant earnings mobility, with average growth rates similar to richer areas. Estimates based on idiosyncratic, firm-specific pay changes show that increases in earnings are linked to migration to better neighborhoods. This results in the earnings of the cohort who lived in a poor neighborhood at baseline growing more than twice as fast as the earnings of these neighborhoods' contemporaneous residents. Overall, our results highlight an underappreciated reason why poor neighborhoods stay poor: initial residents whose earnings grow tend to move away.
abstract_zh: 本文利用连接居住地与收入的新行政数据，研究贫困社区的迁移与收入动态。贫困社区的迁出率高于其他地区，且大多数离开贫困社区的人会迁往更富裕的社区。贫困社区居民的收入流动性也显著，其平均增长率与富裕地区相当。基于个体层面及企业特定薪酬变化的估计表明，收入增长与迁往更优社区存在关联。这导致基线期居住在贫困社区的群体收入增长速度，是同期仍居住在这些社区的居民收入增速的两倍以上。总体而言，我们的研究结果揭示了一个未被充分认识的贫困社区持续贫困的原因：收入增长的初始居民往往会迁离。

title: Economic Sanctions and Taxation of Natural Resource Rent: Evidence From Spatial Analysis
title_zh: 经济制裁与自然资源租金征税：来自空间分析的证据
authors: Isaac Amedanou, Bertrand Laporte, Mahamady Ouédraogo, Bakary Johnson Rouamba
abstract: ABSTRACT This paper examines the effects of economic sanctions on the taxation of natural resources in targeted countries, distinguishing between de jure and de facto measures of the average effective tax rate (AETR) on resource rents. The analysis relies on a sample of 20 African countries for the de jure AETR and a global panel of 75 developing and developed countries for the de facto AETR over the period 2000–2020. Using a Spatial Durbin Model that accounts for spatial spillovers in both taxation and sanctions, we document three main results. First, both resource taxation (de jure and de facto) and economic sanctions exhibit significant spatial dependence across neighbouring countries. Second, economic sanctions affect de jure rent capture, while their impact on de facto AETR is limited and operates mainly through indirect and spillover channels rather than through a direct strengthening of effective tax enforcement. Third, the effects vary by the type and origin of sanctions, with financial sanctions exerting stronger effects than trade sanctions, and UN and US sanctions proving more influential than EU sanctions. The results are robust to alternative measures of sanction intensity, proxied by the number of sanctions imposed, as well as to alternative estimation strategies addressing endogeneity, and dynamic treatment effects. These findings suggest that sanctioned countries adjust formal tax policy in response to sanctions, which contribute to limit the adverse effect of sanctions on their de facto taxation of the resource rent.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了经济制裁对目标国自然资源税收的影响，区分了资源租金平均有效税率（AETR）的法律规定与实际执行指标。分析基于2000-2020年期间两个样本：20个非洲国家的法律规定AETR，以及75个发达国家与发展中国家组成的全球面板数据的实际执行AETR。采用考虑税收与制裁空间溢出效应的空间杜宾模型，我们得出三项主要结论。第一，资源税收（包括法律规定与实际执行）和经济制裁在邻国间均呈现显著的空间依赖性。第二，经济制裁影响法律规定的租金获取，但对实际执行AETR的影响有限，且主要通过间接和溢出渠道发挥作用，而非直接强化有效税收执法。第三，制裁效果因类型和来源而异：金融制裁的影响强于贸易制裁，联合国和美国制裁的影响力超过欧盟制裁。上述结果在采用制裁数量作为制裁强度替代指标、处理内生性的替代估计策略以及动态处理效应检验中均保持稳健。这些发现表明，受制裁国会根据制裁调整正式税收政策，这有助于限制制裁对其资源租金实际征税的不利影响。

title: A qualitative assessment of quantitative easing sentiment
title_zh: 量化宽松情绪的定性评估
authors: Niamh Wylie, Martha O’Hagan‐Luff
abstract: Abstract This mixed‐method study undertakes a comprehensive inquiry of the public discourse on social media surrounding quantitative easing (QE) across the US, the UK, and the European Union. Utilizing a unique tweet dataset, we reveal the sentiment polarity toward QE policy to be strongly negative, at 71.27%, with positive sentiment a mere 4.25%. Distilling the negative QE sentiment, we identify prominent themes of “anti‐government,” “anti‐central bank,” “inequality,” “ineffectiveness,” “inflation,” and “asset inflation,” and demonstrate a longitudinal association between perceived inequality and asset price inflation with an anti‐establishment stance. We conclude with suggested central bank policy recommendations to restore and foster public trust.

abstract: We evaluate equity-efficiency trade-offs from admissions quotas by examining effects on output once beneficiaries start producing in the relevant industry. We estimate the impact of abolishing a 40 percent quota for male primary school teachers on their pupils’ long-run outcomes. title: The Dynamics of Internal Migration: A New Fact and its Implications
title_zh: 内部迁移的动态：一个新事实及其启示
authors: Greg Howard, Hansen Shao
abstract: Abstract We propose a new model of internal migration, based on persistent and spatially correlated idiosyncratic utility. The model is motivated by a new fact in the data that simple moving cost models struggle to match: the t-year interstate migration rate is proportional to the square root of t. The new model maintains the tractability and flexibility of standard migration models, but better matches the dynamics of migration, including the new fact. It has substantially different welfare implications and makes different counterfactual predictions, especially in terms of dynamic adjustment and long-run responses.
